scope: Development experiment on the original already-inspected natural world. This is not a held-out result or the final sustained-learning acceptance.
legacyCalibration: Keep original fits, errors and ledger. Old rows without verified window IDs receive no invented independent calibration. New real windows can establish support.
terminalGoal: The original self position.2 < -14.5 predicate, without route, stages or changed tolerance.

acquisition.actor: Pin a reviewed, fully tested immutable actor before launch, after the separate unchanged 32-decision frame-alignment experiment. Do not change actor during this run.
acquisition.termination: Keep the fixed decision/time bounds and existing fault/no-offer/stall stops. Do not extend a failed acquisition run. Goal confirmation can occur inside continued autonomous acquisition.

matchedEvaluation.eligibility: After the acquisition has stopped and its world/model/raw evidence is preserved and audited. Failure to acquire useful support is a negative result, not permission to invent calibration or change the goal.
matchedEvaluation.initialWorld: Three new verified copies of the same original initial world and nonlearning session state; never reuse a runtime mutated by an earlier launch.
matchedEvaluation.retainedModel: Only dynamics and affordances from the stopped acquisition donor. Preserve initial choices, tasks, world-memory state, body and world bytes.
matchedEvaluation.erasedModel: Erase dynamics and affordances only, with the original model seed and unchanged nonlearning state.
matchedEvaluation.budgetClarification: 191 was a historical executed-action result under 192 decisions, not a new action-budget setting. Refusals remain in the original 192-decision denominator.
matchedEvaluation.verification: Use the existing multiple-distinct-real-frame terminal confirmation and independently audit raw windows and engine position readings. Initial goal must be unsatisfied.

unchanged: 100/50 ms native planning deadlines and node budgets
actual motor holds and exact action-start binding
measures: goal success, actual actions, all decisions, refusals, deaths
each measured motor's distinct real windows, separating passive and active observations
goal-axis and all-field supported prediction coverage, actual interval hit rate and widths
goal-axis support for actions with an actual measurable position change
pressed duration, released duration and total observed window duration
new writes versus retained historical writes
nextStage: Only after an actual useful A benefit is supported by the matched results, preregister a perceptibly different physical mechanism B and return to exactly the same initial A for frozen retention testing. Then test unseen real prerequisite compositions. Do not treat this single development comparison as B-E or long-term acceptance.
integrity: No concurrent CPU experiments during native comparisons. Record source, build and harness hashes, exact loaded model SHA, world-copy provenance, raw actual windows, learning digests and stopped-world archive. A timer overrun, fault or partial run is retained, not silently retried.
